booking_pages_buffers.name: booking_pages_buffers
booking_pages_buffers.value: "slotly"."booking_pages"."buffer_before_minutes" between 0 and 240 and "slotly"."booking_pages"."buffer_before_minutes" % 5 = 0 and "slotly"."booking_pages"."buffer_after_minutes" between 0 and 240 and "slotly"."booking_pages"."buffer_after_minutes" % 5 = 0

booking_events_request.name: booking_events_request
booking_events_request.value: ("slotly"."booking_events"."request_id" is null) = ("slotly"."booking_events"."request_hash" is null) and ("slotly"."booking_events"."request_hash" is null or "slotly"."booking_events"."request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

booking_events_reason.name: booking_events_reason
booking_events_reason.value: ("slotly"."booking_events"."reason" is null or length(trim("slotly"."booking_events"."reason")) between 1 and 1000) and ("slotly"."booking_events"."type" = 'cancelled' or "slotly"."booking_events"."reason" is null) and ("slotly"."booking_events"."type" <> 'cancelled' or "slotly"."booking_events"."actor" <> 'organizer' or "slotly"."booking_events"."reason" is not null)

booking_events_shape.name: booking_events_shape
booking_events_shape.value:
(
    ("slotly"."booking_events"."type" = 'created' and "slotly"."booking_events"."version" = 1 and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_start_at" is null and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_end_at" is null and "slotly"."booking_events"."new_start_at" is not null and "slotly"."booking_events"."new_end_at" is not null) or
    ("slotly"."booking_events"."type" = 'rescheduled' and "slotly"."booking_events"."version" > 1 and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_start_at" is not null and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_end_at" is not null and "slotly"."booking_events"."new_start_at" is not null and "slotly"."booking_events"."new_end_at" is not null and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_start_at" <> "slotly"."booking_events"."new_start_at") or
    ("slotly"."booking_events"."type" = 'cancelled' and "slotly"."booking_events"."version" > 1 and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_start_at" is not null and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_end_at" is not null and "slotly"."booking_events"."new_start_at" is null and "slotly"."booking_events"."new_end_at" is null)
  )

booking_events_bounds.name: booking_events_bounds
booking_events_bounds.value: ("slotly"."booking_events"."old_start_at" is null or (isfinite("slotly"."booking_events"."old_start_at") and isfinite("slotly"."booking_events"."old_end_at") and "slotly"."booking_events"."old_start_at" < "slotly"."booking_events"."old_end_at")) and ("slotly"."booking_events"."new_start_at" is null or (isfinite("slotly"."booking_events"."new_start_at") and isfinite("slotly"."booking_events"."new_end_at") and "slotly"."booking_events"."new_start_at" < "slotly"."booking_events"."new_end_at"))

bookings_guest_email.name: bookings_guest_email
bookings_guest_email.value: length("slotly"."bookings"."guest_email") between 3 and 254 and "slotly"."bookings"."guest_email" = lower(trim("slotly"."bookings"."guest_email")) and position('@' in "slotly"."bookings"."guest_email") > 1

occupancies_buffers.name: occupancies_buffers
occupancies_buffers.value: "slotly"."occupancies"."buffer_before_minutes" between 0 and 240 and "slotly"."occupancies"."buffer_before_minutes" % 5 = 0 and "slotly"."occupancies"."buffer_after_minutes" between 0 and 240 and "slotly"."occupancies"."buffer_after_minutes" % 5 = 0

occupancies_duration.name: occupancies_duration
occupancies_duration.value: "slotly"."occupancies"."kind" = 'manual' or (extract(epoch from ("slotly"."occupancies"."end_at" - "slotly"."occupancies"."start_at")) between 300 and 28800 and mod(extract(epoch from ("slotly"."occupancies"."end_at" - "slotly"."occupancies"."start_at")), 300) = 0)

guest_challenges_contact.name: guest_challenges_contact
guest_challenges_contact.value: length(trim("slotly"."guest_challenges"."guest_name")) between 1 and 100 and "slotly"."guest_challenges"."guest_email" = lower(trim("slotly"."guest_challenges"."guest_email")) and position('@' in "slotly"."guest_challenges"."guest_email") > 1 and slotly.is_known_timezone("slotly"."guest_challenges"."guest_timezone")

guest_challenges_consumption.name: guest_challenges_consumption
guest_challenges_consumption.value: ("slotly"."guest_challenges"."consumed_at" is null) = ("slotly"."guest_challenges"."booking_id" is null) and ("slotly"."guest_challenges"."consumed_at" is null or (isfinite("slotly"."guest_challenges"."consumed_at") and "slotly"."guest_challenges"."invalidated_at" is null))

notification_outbox_terminal.name: notification_outbox_terminal
notification_outbox_terminal.value: not ("slotly"."notification_outbox"."sent_at" is not null and "slotly"."notification_outbox"."failed_at" is not null) and (("slotly"."notification_outbox"."sent_at" is null and "slotly"."notification_outbox"."failed_at" is null) or "slotly"."notification_outbox"."lease_token" is null)

notification_outbox_finite.name: notification_outbox_finite
notification_outbox_finite.value: isfinite("slotly"."notification_outbox"."available_at") and isfinite("slotly"."notification_outbox"."created_at") and ("slotly"."notification_outbox"."locked_until" is null or isfinite("slotly"."notification_outbox"."locked_until")) and ("slotly"."notification_outbox"."sent_at" is null or isfinite("slotly"."notification_outbox"."sent_at")) and ("slotly"."notification_outbox"."failed_at" is null or isfinite("slotly"."notification_outbox"."failed_at"))
